# Tokenimizer

> Personal journal of Tokenimizer, principal developer at Hidden Tokens.

The site shares notes on building Hidden Tokens, privacy-first AI workflows, projects, tools, and setups. Hidden Tokens anonymises documents locally before they are sent to AI services. Profile and repository details sourced from GitHub may change.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://tokenimizer.github.io/): Profile, projects, and recent journal entries.
- [Journal](https://tokenimizer.github.io/journal/): All published journal entries.
- [RSS feed](https://tokenimizer.github.io/feed.xml): Subscribe to new entries.
- [Hidden Tokens](https://hiddentokens.com/): Product website.
